summary: Mid-cycle pricing tariff change triggered ad-hoc credit reallocation and unexpected invoice delta
description: Issue summary: Customer reports a $12,430 delta on their March invoice after a mid-cycle manual pricing tariff override. Impact: unexpected negative balance followed by an automated reserve deduction that deducted promotional credits from the customer account and applied them to a sibling org. Environment: prod | us-west, dedicated pool ID dp-78. Timeline: 2026-03-10 23:42 UTC manual tariff change (internal finance), 2026-03-11 03:15 UTC late usage postbacks processed, 2026-03-11 04:02 UTC invoice re-eval produced adjustment lines. Customer noticed invoice difference on 2026-03-11 morning and opened ticket.
steps_to_reproduce: 2) Query hourly postbacks for 2026-03-10 00:00-2026-03-11 06:00 UTC (postback batch id pb-20260311-3)
3) Re-run pricing engine with pre-change tariff and post-change tariff to compare allocation of promo credits
4) Inspect invoice INV-2026-03-11-0099 and line items tagged 'promo_credit_adjustment'
5) Check audit log for manual tariff update (audit id AU-20260310-78)
6) Confirm if reserved capacity activation at 2026-03-10 23:40 triggered plan reconciliation
logs: pb-20260311-3: processed 14,320 postbacks; ordering mismatch detected for org novus-889 and sibling novus-889-staging
pricing-engine: reconcile run pr-2026-03-11-04:02 produced credit_reallocation event with id cr-7741
invoice-service: INV-2026-03-11-0099 lines: base_usage:$18,320, promo_credit_adjustment:-$12,430, reserve_reconciliation:$1,200
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: manual tariff override changed the price-tier mapping mid-cycle causing the billing engine to re-evaluate postbacks and reassign promo credits based on new tariff priority rules.
Data pull: Retrieved postback ordering: some pb events arrived out-of-order (delayed by ~45m) which the legacy postback reconciler reprocessed when tariff changed.

Found that promo credits were tagged to a billing entity id that is shared across prod and staging; reconciliation logic uses tariff priority + billing entity to allocate credits — manual override updated tariff precedence, so credits were moved to sibling org.
Checked audit: AU-20260310-78 shows finance user 'mcarter' applied 'enterprise-tariff-v3' override for dp-78 at 2026-03-10 23:42 UTC.
Temporary mitigation: disabled automatic mid-cycle re-eval pipline for tariff overrides (flag: disable-midcycle-realloc) to prevent further reallocations while we fix root cause.

Required fix: pricing-engine should not reallocate previously-applied promotional credits retroactively on manual tariff changes; instead, it should produce a non-destructive notification and create a re-run candidate for manual approval.
